name: Cake Tower HUD
description:
为蛋糕塔 Chapter 3（Cake Team Towers）设计的游戏信息面板。快捷栏上方显示自己的状态，队友列表和头顶血条显示血量与各类心。按 F8 调整面板位置、左右对齐、数字简写、盾牌冷却、箭矢提示和屏幕标题，按 N 打开实验性伤害统计与分关表。分关表优先使用进入地牢时的副标题。客户端可单独安装，服务端可选装以同步血量、心数、属性与 NPC 标记。战绩广播默认关闭。
Custom HUD for Cake Team Towers Chapter 3 with personal status bars, party and overhead health bars, character stats, shield cooldown, and an arrow preview. Press F8 to configure the display or N to open the experimental combat and stage tables. Dungeon names use the entry subtitle when available. Optional server installation synchronizes health, heart counts, stats, and NPC markers. Chat reports are off by default.
